records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Installs Odoo Community 19.0 under ~/odoo-site on an Oteny bot box when the owner asks, and serves as the shared JSON-2 client, owner-setup, team-login and migration layer for WebsiteBot/CrmBot. Not for installing website/crm modules itself, not for building sites or capturing leads, not to install just because the tree is missing; it does not authorize account creation or bulk identity changes on its own.
records.content_finding: Technically careful Odoo 19 engineering (JSON-2 bearer API, group_ids, case-sensitive login lesson, confirm-gated CRUD/SQL, secret-safe password handling, honest failure tokens) makes it useful reference material. Unchanged use fails the authority gate: an auto-run migration bulk-renames user logins and rewrites sibling bots' credential files without confirmation, and team-login creation is open to anyone in chat with bot-chosen privilege groups. Heavily coupled to the Oteny/Hermes hosted platform and a sibling preflight.py that the package does not ship.
records.bundled_file_findings: scripts/install_odoo.sh: RAM/disk/ensurepip gates, installs postgres via sibling Talent, venv, unpinned `pip install --upgrade pip wheel`, shallow git clone odoo 19.0, pip install filtered requirements, release.py major check. ensure_odoo.sh: starts Postgres then Odoo (setsid, 0.0.0.0:8069), one-time `-i base` init, curl probes. install_modules.sh: `-i <mods>` then pin_crm_home.py for crm. pin_crm_home.py: runs `odoo shell` subprocess to set CRM menu sequence and admin home action. local_odoo_rpc.py: JSON-2 bearer client to 127.0.0.1:8069, reads api_key from .odoo-admin, attach_file posts chatter message. local_odoo_paths.py: cross-bot .odoo-admin locator, login normalisation, admin-file state machine. crud.py/rpc.py/sql.py: confirm-gated writes; sql.py shells psql with secret-column/DROP DATABASE refusals and 200-line cap. list_models/fields/views.py: read-only introspection. team_login.py: create/set-password/check/can/lowercase-all over JSON-2 + /web/session/authenticate; passwords from env only; lowercase-all writes logins and rewrites .odoo-admin files. wait_for_public_dns.py: raw UDP DNS to 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8 + DoH fallback, 60 s poll. migrate.py / neutralize.py / check_neutralize.py / selfcheck.py (35 KB, read): shared Oteny runners - migration markers, clone de-fanging (sqlite scripts, disabling crons in jobs.json), read-only readiness judge incl. stdlib YAML fallback and connection-receipt SHA-256 check; neutralize.py is shipped though this Talent has no neutralize.yaml. migrations.yaml/required_artifacts.yaml/agent-profile.yaml: manifests, routing channel_prompt (role-setting, no system override), no secrets. tests/unit (6 files) and tests/scenarios (2 yaml): pytest offline gates with placeholder credential fixtures (dummy password/api_key strings, example.com logins) and live Telegram scenarios; not executed.
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: Good gates: install is a hard stop until the owner says yes (first-run.md); unregister needs confirm; crud.py/rpc.py create/write/unlink and mutating sql.py require --confirm/confirm:true after showing vals; sql.py refuses DROP DATABASE and password/api_key/totp columns; passwords only via connect_account secure link and env vars, never argv/chat; team_login.py never echoes argv. Failures: (1) the lowercase-logins migration is run on any triage that prints MIGRATIONS: pending - team_login.py lowercase-all renames every internal res.users login (and email) and rewrites the .odoo-admin credential files of sibling bots (crm-bot, odoo-website, ~/odoo-site) with only an after-the-fact notice to the owner, no per-action confirmation (identity/credential operation, persistent writes into other Talents' state); (2) team-logins.md says 'Anyone you answer may ask' and 'Which groups a person gets is your decision' - in group chats any participant can trigger creation of an internal Odoo user with copied privilege groups and the bot picks groups, with no owner confirmation of the account+groups before create; (3) ensure_odoo.sh deliberately binds 0.0.0.0:8069 ('Never 127.0.0.1 only') while a fresh DB still has Odoo's default admin login until setup_admin rotates it; (4) the install clones the moving 19.0 branch tip and pip-installs its requirements (owner-gated but unpinned). setup.md slug_taken recipe silently retries host_website under a randomly suffixed public name. Plaintext admin password and API key stored in 0600 .odoo-admin files, readable across three bots by design. No telemetry beyond platform tools; DNS checks hit public resolvers with the hostname.
records.capability_specific: Install Odoo Community 19 locally; JSON-2 CRUD, SQL, team logins

rubric_dimension_rationale.trigger_precision: 2/2: 'What the owner types' table plus explicit 'Do not start ... owner must ask', 'do not install because the tree is missing', and local-odoo-client.md scope limits.
rubric_dimension_rationale.procedural_clarity: 2/2: Numbered INSTALL drill with exact scripts and expected tokens (ODOO_INSTALLED, ODOO_UP), triage commands, and token tables in team-logins.md/migrations.md.
rubric_dimension_rationale.authority_safety: 0/2: Authority hard gate fails: lowercase-logins migration renames all internal logins and rewrites other bots' .odoo-admin files on triage with no confirm; team login creation open to 'anyone you answer' with bot-chosen groups.
rubric_dimension_rationale.failure_handling: 2/2: Rich failure tokens: ODOO_INSTALL_REFUSED mem/disk/ensurepip, release.py major check, ODOO_DOWN with log tail, LOWERCASE_LATER do-not-mark, TWIN handling, CHECK_FAILED cause lines.
rubric_dimension_rationale.evidence_discipline: 2/2: 'Quote only a record id, a count, or rows a script printed this turn', 'Never state a cause that no check printed', do not invent public URL.
rubric_dimension_rationale.dependency_coherence: 1/2: Sibling postgres Talent exists at pin, but local-odoo-client.md runs odoo-community/scripts/preflight.py which is absent from the package; depends on proprietary platform tools (register_service, connect_account, host_website).
rubric_dimension_rationale.portability_honesty: 1/2: Honest that it targets 'your private box' and Oteny tools, but hard-codes ~/.hermes paths, Telegram, plan tiers ('upgrade to Power or Max') without stating non-Oteny limits.
rubric_dimension_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: 1/2: Odoo 19 JSON-2 client, login-case lesson and confirm-gated CRUD are reusable; the installer itself is a generic Odoo install wrapped in vendor plumbing.
rubric_dimension_rationale.adversarial_resilience: 1/2: Secret-column SQL refusal, password-never-on-argv parser, env-name validation; but group-chat 'anyone may ask' login creation and 0.0.0.0 bind with default admin until rotation weaken it.
rubric_dimension_rationale.effectiveness_design: 1/2: Unit tests and live scenarios exist and target real regressions, but no owner-confirmation test for migrations/logins.

records.content_finding: Detailed, battle-tested operational notes (Odoo 19 homepage_url, JSON-2 only, DNS-before-URL, slug collision handling, honest install times) but it is essentially an operator manual for the proprietary Oteny hosting platform. The authority gate fails because publishing can occur under an unconfirmed address via silent slug retries (and the e2e harness tolerates hosting before go-ahead), edits on a live site publish immediately with unsanitised HTML, and inherited migrations mutate identities unprompted. A default-on vendor backlink in every customer site and repeated subscription-upgrade prompts make it commercial/promotional; reference only at best.
records.bundled_file_findings: scripts/preflight.py: read-only per-turn status (install, ODOO serving, profile fields, ADMIN/ADMIN_FILE, JSON2 bearer check, memory/substrate, community migrations line). setup_admin.py: authenticates with stored or default admin/admin, writes new login/password via JSON-2 session, mints an rpc API key through an `odoo shell` subprocess snippet, rotates database.secret/uuid and odoo.conf admin_passwd on --rotate-clone-secrets, writes .odoo-admin (0600) in two locations; refuses bare run on bake_placeholder. site_module.py: scaffolds oteny_site_<slug> addon (manifest LGPL-3, QWeb homepage with raw body_html, post_init_hook setting homepage_url), git init/commit/revert, pkill Odoo then `-i/-u --stop-after-init` and restart, git-remote add+push. site_rpc.py: JSON-2 set-homepage (raw body in ir.ui.view arch, publishes page) and set-base-url (https only). write_profile.py: writes profile.yaml with lowercased email. normalize_pg_locales.py: rewrites lc_* in postgresql.conf to C.UTF-8 with post-check. website_paths.py: data-dir and cross-bot admin-file resolution, imports odoo-community modules by path. ensure_site.sh: execs odoo-community ensure_odoo.sh. migrate/neutralize/check_neutralize/selfcheck.py: byte-identical copies of the odoo-community shared runners; neutralize.yaml disables the site health-check cron on clones. profile/*.template: profile, USER.md, memory.md templates (placeholders only). agent-profile.yaml (12 KB): store copy, changelog, routing channel_prompt (role-setting, no system override). tests/unit (7) and tests/scenarios (9): offline pytest gates with dummy credential fixtures (one fixture uses a vendor-domain email with a placeholder password) and live Telegram scenarios; not executed.
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: Gates present: intake-only first reply with hard stop; confirm before first publish (host_website) and before unhost; custom-domain attach after confirm; passwords only via secure connect_account link and env, never chat; site_module refuses to commit .odoo-admin/.env/ssh keys. Failures: (1) on slug_taken the bot silently retries host_website twice under randomly suffixed public names and publishes without asking the owner (they approved a different address); (2) tests/scenarios/vm_commission_e2e.yaml turn 4 explicitly accepts the bot 'racing ahead' and calling host_website before the go-ahead, so the publish gate is not enforced by the harness; (3) triage runs pending odoo-community migrations (lowercase-logins: bulk login rename + credential-file rewrites) without confirmation; (4) site_module.py set-homepage commits and runs `-i/-u` immediately (pkill of Odoo processes, restart), so content edits go live on a hosted site with no separate publish confirm, and body_html is inserted raw into QWeb/arch ('trusted owner content the bot already sanitized' - no sanitizer exists); (5) every built site gets a vendor promotional footer backlink to oteny.com/business by default on first build, framed as 'the owner's own boast'; removal only on request. git-remote pushes site code to an owner-supplied remote after credential intake. setup_admin.py rotates Odoo's default admin/admin, writes plaintext password + API key to multiple 0600 files, rotates database.secret on clone. Owner PII (email, name, timezone) written to profile.yaml and auto-loaded USER.md memory; no third-party egress beyond the vendor platform.

rubric_dimension_rationale.trigger_precision: 2/2: Owner-phrase table maps each request to an action; explicit bans on drop.oteny.bot/http.server and 'Do not start ... owner must ask'.
rubric_dimension_rationale.procedural_clarity: 2/2: Clear triage via preflight.py, numbered BUILD+HOST steps with exact commands, module vs JSON-2 locked-path table.
rubric_dimension_rationale.authority_safety: 0/2: Hard gate fails: silent host_website retries under unapproved random-suffix names; e2e accepts hosting before go-ahead; set-homepage goes live without confirm; inherited unconfirmed login migration.
rubric_dimension_rationale.failure_handling: 2/2: Handles slug_taken, DNS propagation (PUBLIC_URL_READY + edge_reachable), PROFILE_WRITE_FAILED stop, ensure restarts after failed -u, owner_password_required refusal.
rubric_dimension_rationale.evidence_discipline: 1/2: Do not give URL until checks pass and never a silent swap of address, but body_html is passed raw with a false 'already sanitized' claim and docs disagree on '/oteny_subscribe upgrade power' vs 'max'.
rubric_dimension_rationale.dependency_coherence: 1/2: Sibling odoo-community/postgres present at pin and imported by path; relies on many proprietary platform tools and plugins not in the package; upgrade-tier guidance inconsistent across SKILL.md, site_module.py and agent-profile.
rubric_dimension_rationale.portability_honesty: 0/2: Locked to *.oteny.bot hosting, Telegram, Oteny plans and an injected promotional backlink framed as the owner's own boast; non-Oteny use is not addressed.
rubric_dimension_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: 1/2: Odoo 19 site-module scaffolding and JSON-2 homepage editing are reusable ideas, but most content is vendor platform choreography.
rubric_dimension_rationale.adversarial_resilience: 1/2: Never asks for secrets in chat, refuses committing secret files; but raw HTML injection into QWeb and 'only publish content the owner is entitled to' is a single line with no check.
rubric_dimension_rationale.effectiveness_design: 1/2: Extensive scenario suite and unit tests, though the commission e2e explicitly tolerates skipping the publish confirmation.

records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Knowledge skill for the bot's visceral-fat reduction method (sleep, distributed protein/leucine, zone-2 cardio, resistance, TRE, food anchors) and per-body path selection by waist-to-height ratio. Not medical advice; not for pregnancy, type-1/insulin-dependent diabetes, eating-disorder signals or minors, and it does not authorize prescribing deficits outside the stated floors.
records.content_finding: Coherent, specific method with a genuinely useful derive-don't-bake WHtR path and explicit safety floors. Evidence discipline is weaker than claimed: several precise effect sizes have no source (berries -10-15%, fiber '-15% Japanese 2026 trial', EVOO 'up to 3x faster', omega-3 2026), observational associations (Aberdeen 2023, irregular sleep) are presented alongside RCTs as levers, and 'protocol helps reverse insulin resistance' sits uneasily with the no-reversal-promise rule. Platform-specific tool hooks (talent_lesson) limit portability.
records.bundled_file_findings: Four markdown references: protocol.md (90-day method body, 'three points popular advice gets wrong'), why-visceral-fat.md (education, TOFI, sources incl. NICE NG246), food-ideas.md (staples/meal templates), research-dossier.md (effect sizes with URLs). No scripts.
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: No consequential actions or data flows; purely advisory text. Consumes tenant body metrics from profile. Hard guards present: 1,200 kcal floor, <=1%/wk sustained, no prescription below WHtR 0.4 / goal BMI 18.5, red-flag escalation via ../references/safety-boundaries.md (which covers ED signals, pregnancy, T1D/insulin, exertional chest pain/syncope). No age floor for minors anywhere in the method (onboarding accepts age 13).
records.capability_specific: Visceral-fat lifestyle method with WHtR-based path derivation and citations

rubric_dimension_rationale.procedural_clarity: 2/2: 'Deriving the natural path' gives ordered steps (WHtR bands -> path -> %BW rate -> protein basis -> universal floors).
rubric_dimension_rationale.authority_safety: 2/2: advisory only, no actions; floors and safety-boundary link are explicit and labelled hard guards.
rubric_dimension_rationale.failure_handling: 1/2: floors and ED guard handle extremes, but no handling for minors, medication interactions or missing waist data beyond deferral elsewhere.
rubric_dimension_rationale.evidence_discipline: 1/2: citation policy is good, yet multiple effect sizes in research-dossier.md lack sources and associations are framed as causal levers.
rubric_dimension_rationale.dependency_coherence: 1/2: depends on sibling safety-boundaries.md (present) and the proprietary talent_lesson tool/profile.yaml.
rubric_dimension_rationale.portability_honesty: 1/2: content portable as text, but framed around 'tenant', Hermes profile paths and Oteny tooling without stating the lock-in.
rubric_dimension_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: 2/2: per-body-type rate in %BW with WHtR as primary metric is a differentiated, reusable mechanism.
rubric_dimension_rationale.adversarial_resilience: 1/2: no injected instructions; but would coach a deficit to any user incl. teens since no age gate.
rubric_dimension_rationale.effectiveness_design: 1/2: compact lever ranking is effective, though precise percentages invite overconfident coaching.
